item.title: The revival of Rancho San Marcos
item.description: By Mike Miller Golf enthusiasts on the Central Coast received welcome news earlier this year when it was announced that the Rancho San Marcos Golf Course was coming back online. The beloved course closed back in 2020, leaving local golfers and residents alike wondering what would become of the property. item.title: Everything’s Coming up Roses in Fillmore
item.description: Otto and Sons Nursery is the go-to spot for roses and all things garden Story and photos by Adam Nuñez Just a few miles outside of downtown Fillmore you’ll find the largest selection of roses this side of the Rocky Mountains. This is Otto and Sons, a nursery specializing in all sorts of roses – more than 800 varieties, in fact.
